mapper.sql: c.cand_id,c.cand_no,c.cand_nm,c.cand_se_cd,c.vndr_ptnr_id,c.job_cd,c.grd_cd, c.hope_untprc_amt,c.asgn_psbl_dt AS avail_dt,c.cntct_stts_cd,c.tel_no,c.cand_src_cd AS source, c.memo_desc AS rmrk_desc,c.use_yn,c.dev_id,c.last_cntct_dt,c.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hr.cand c WHERE c.cand_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM hr.cand c WHERE c.cand_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM hr.cand c ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) AS candidate_count,count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.cntct_stts_cd='INTV') AS interview_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.asgn_psbl_dt <= (date_trunc('month',#{today}::date)+interval '2 months - 1 day')::date) AS available_by_next_month_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE #{today}::date-coalesce(c.last_cntct_dt,c.created_at::date)>30) AS uncontacted_over_30_days_count FROM hr.cand c
SELECT skl_cd FROM hr.cand_skl WHERE cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY skl_cd
SELECT cntct_dt,cntct_stts_cd,memo_desc AS memo,rcrd_user_id AS user_id,created_at FROM hr.cand_cntct_hist WHERE cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY cntct_dt DESC,created_at DESC,cntct_hist_id DESC

SELECT n.need_id,n.oppt_id,o.oppt_nm,n.job_cd,n.bgn_ym,n.expc_untprc_amt AS monthly_price, (SELECT sum(v.num_val) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (oprt_std_id) oprt_std_id,num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id IN ('TEAM_FEE','PROJECT_EXP') AND aply_bgn_ym<=n.bgn_ym ORDER BY oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym DESC) v HAVING count(v.num_val)=2) AS team_expense FROM hr.cand c JOIN bsn.oppt_need n ON n.job_cd=c.job_cd JOIN bsn.oppt o ON o.oppt_id=n.oppt_id WHERE c.cand_id=#{id} AND o.oppt_stts_cd='OPEN' AND c.asgn_psbl_dt<=(to_date(n.bgn_ym,'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date ORDER BY n.bgn_ym,n.need_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group} AND dtl_cd=#{code} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y' AND ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH'))
mapper.update: UPDATE hr.cand c SET last_cntct_dt=h.cntct_dt,cntct_stts_cd=CASE WHEN c.dev_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SIGNED' ELSE h.cntct_stts_cd END FROM (SELECT cntct_dt,cntct_stts_cd FROM hr.cand_cntct_hist WHERE cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY cntct_dt DESC,created_at DESC,cntct_hist_id DESC LIMIT 1) h WHERE c.cand_id=#{id} AND (c.last_cntct_dt IS DISTINCT FROM h.cntct_dt OR c.cntct_stts_cd IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN c.dev_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SIGNED' ELSE h.cntct_stts_cd END)
UPDATE hr.cand SET dev_id=#{developerId},cntct_stts_cd='SIGNED',updated_by=#{actor} WHERE cand_id=#{id} AND dev_id IS NULL
UPDATE mst.dev SET src_cand_id=#{id} WHERE dev_id=#{developerId}
